scope: Allow published Media Library video asset IDs to authorize a Media Library poster asset reference.

finding.reproduction: The published public renderer supports video props.assetId and posterAssetId independently. The shared public media authorization scanner only recognized a video props.src URL as a valid video source, so a Media Library video with no external src made its otherwise rendered poster reference return HTTP 404.
finding.regression_before_fix: The updated media API regression failed against the old predicate: the published poster asset returned 404 where the assertion required 200.
finding.fix: Treat a strictly validated UUID-shaped props.assetId as a valid video source alongside the existing safeMediaUrl props.src path. The poster remains gated by video node type, source validity, and image MIME compatibility; publication/site scoping checks are unchanged.
finding.regression_after_fix: The poster-video fixture uses a real UUID Media Library video assetId with no src and confirms its published poster asset resolves through the shared public media route.
